name: grid-layout
title: Apply Grid Layout
description: Applies a known grid topology to a React page/component root or exact nested construction target and creates addressable data-area construction seats using existing DOM edit Tools.

settings.name: component
settings.title: Page or Component
settings.description: Optional React page/component name to receive the grid.

settings.name: file
settings.title: File
settings.description: Optional source file to receive the grid.

settings.name: seat_id
settings.title: Construction Seat ID
settings.description: Optional exact data-rab-seat target for a nested grid.

settings.name: area
settings.title: Target Data Area
settings.description: Optional data-area target for a nested grid when an exact seat is not supplied.

settings.name: layout
settings.title: Grid Layout
settings.description: Known layout name from the shared grid catalog.
